question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Ritika was deprived of her father’s property as she married a __knave.__
solution:
The correct answer is 'Rogue'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Knave'** means '**dishonest' or 'unscrupulous' man.**
 
• **'Rogue'** means '**dishonest' or 'unprincipled person'.**
 
• The above two words are very similar to each other.
 
• Therefore the **Synonym** of the word '**Knave'** is '***Rogue**'*. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The meaning of the other given words are 

 
• '**Gallant'** means -'**showy in dress or bearing'**, smart, splendid, stately. brave.
 
• **'Novice'** means' **a person new to and ****inexperienced in a job or situation'. **
 
• **'chauffeur'** means '**someone whose job is to drive a car for a rich or important person'.**
